source: User-supplied Qwen3.7 voting experiment report.pdf, Next experiments, pages 6-7
latest_user_instruction: Prepare and publish the plan/code first; start only after the user confirms. E1 replaces the PDF's Qwen-Max/GPT-4o with DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash-1017 and Qwen3.8-Flash.

heldout.role: E0 fixed direct baseline only; no tuning or method selection

e1_ensemble.tie_rule: D only when among tied leading options, otherwise alphabetical; all missing remains missing

e2.batch: All complete questions/options of one case and their unique original images in one request; JSON answers keyed by original question_id
e2.sequential: One conversation per case in frozen source order; only previous questions and actual prior assistant outputs are retained; reset between cases
e2.official_notebook_relation: Only the within-case conversation idea is adopted; no official agent, tools, or additional letter-only request
e2.failed_batch: Missing or malformed child answers remain missing on the fixed 402-question denominator; never repeat a paid batch

e3.cache_unit: One evidence file per case, each tool at most once per unique eligible original image within that case
e3.eligible_modality: CXR explicitly established by frozen image metadata/caption or human review; CT/MRI/unknown skipped
e3.tool_outputs: Unverified hypotheses, possibly wrong; original images stay in every question request
e3.missing_evidence: Answer using original input with explicit NO_EVIDENCE; retain failures and coverage

statistics.retain_arm_rule: paired case-bootstrap improvement CI lower endpoint > 0
statistics.mcnemar: two-sided exact question-level, case dependence addressed separately by cluster bootstrap
statistics.multiple_comparisons: Exploratory tuning comparisons; report all six candidate views and no independent method generalization claim
statistics.e1_complementarity: Report corrections/harms and union coverage of D's 107 errors; the PDF's about-15-of-106 heuristic is diagnostic only
statistics.e0: Fixed heldout D accuracy and case-bootstrap accuracy CI only; do not compare unpaired splits as a method effect

ledger_validation: User-cancelled V12 checksum/schema/policy/full-table reconciliation remains disabled; no replacement scans. Necessary reads, identity, locks, cap, arithmetic, deduplication and hard token/request bounds remain.
failure_policy: Preserve original failed/unparsed terminals; no resending an unknown sent outcome; only non-quota HTTP429 permits at most one technical retry; five consecutive failures or systemic identity/auth/permission/quota/runtime errors stop for targeted review.
publication: Publish complete questions/options/original images, actual requests/responses, evidence and failures, full denominators, paired corrections/harms, usage/timing and limitations; exclude credentials, account ledgers, private absolute paths and weights. Preserve all prior reports.
